long_biography.plain_text:
Peter Dahlstrom worked with designers and creative technologists on McKinsey’s Reinvention campaign, turning an argument about adaptability into a moving sculpture. Its changing shapes illustrated the firm’s work across industries. As head of communications, he saw the project’s combination of design, engineering and practical construction as an expression of how consulting was changing.

In Fast Times, co-written with three colleagues, he argues that businesses should learn from customers and test early prototypes with them. Responsibility for understanding customers extends throughout an organisation, from the chief executive to the data scientist. The book won a silver Axiom Business Book Award in 2021.
